text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + container restarts on serving-prod-gpu pool (gpu nodes). Automatic page to on-call.

Jaime: Im on. Summary? Which node and container IDs?

Priya: Seeing OOMs during large prefill on node gpu-11, container runtime-22a4c. Log snippet: 

Priya: ```
2024-06-12T02:45:12Z runtime ERROR cuda failed: out of memory trying to allocate 9.8 GiB
2024-06-12T02:45:12Z prefill: requested context_tokens=110000, kv_allocating -> seq_len=110000
2024-06-12T02:45:13Z runtime INFO sigkill received, container restart
```

Lukas: That context size is >100k tokens. Looks like a customer sent a long-archive paste. Were hitting both KV-cache allocation and pinned memory fragmentation.

Jaime: Priority mitigations: 1) temporary per-tenant prefill abort for requests >50k tokens, returning 422; 2) enable on-the-fly prefix trimming to drop older history during prefill; 3) route heavy requests to low-memory quantized nodes if possible. Thoughts?

Priya: I can flip a feature-flag to enforce prefill_abort_limit=50000 at the edge; patching edge-nginx/lambda to reject upstreams now.

infra-bot: Applying config: `edge/limits.json` updated, rollout to edges in 12s.

Priya: Patch applied. Edge now rejects requests >50k tokens with 422 and includes guidance to retry with shortened context.

Lukas: Also enabling runtime fallback: `RUNTIME_PREFILL_STRATEGY=trim_and_stream` which will trim oldest prefixes during prefill. Deploying to a canary set.

eng-runtime: Canary shows trimmed prefill paths avoid OOM but increases latency ~120ms for the affected requests. No crashes observed on canary for 15m.

Jaime: Good. Can we also temporarily reduce per-request kv-reservation multiplier? If we change kv_multiplier from 1.0 -> 0.5 for the next hour it may avoid large contiguous allocations.

eng-runtime: We have a hotconfig that reduces reservation and prefers incremental growth. Rolling to prod with 30s stagger.

Priya: Noted. Also marking gpu-11 unschedulable and migrating non-critical pods off it: `kubectl cordon gpu-11` then `kubectl drain gpu-11 --ignore-daemonsets`.

infra-bot: Drain in progress. One pod failed graceful termination due to local checkpointing; evicted forcefully.

Lukas: Kernel log from gpu-11 shows: 

Lukas: ```
Jun 12 02:45:14 gpu-11 kernel: NVRM: Xid (0x4e) 00000000: 36:11: GPU fault: process 0x0, reason OOM/pinned allocation
Jun 12 02:45:14 gpu-11 kernel: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

Jaime: That maps to fragmented pinned allocations on the driver side. We're coordinating a planned driver update on gpu-11 once drained.

Customer Success: We have two customers reporting increased 5xx around 02:45-02:48 UTC. Drafting notifications and opening tickets CS-4601 and CS-4602. Both impacted by long-context features.

Priya: Edge limit in place should prevent new huge prefill attempts. For current in-flight ones, runtime trimming is handling most. We're seeing error rate drop from 5% -> 0.6% over the last 8 minutes.

eng-runtime: Canary reduction in kv_reservation applied to 10% of pods: memory pressure down 30% on those pods. No regressions. Proceeding to full rollout with 10s stagger.

Lukas: After rollout, GPU OOMs stop across pool; only affected node remains offline (gpu-11). Driver update scheduled.

Jaime: Prep incident summary for handoff: cause: oversized prefill from long-context requests causing large KV allocations + driver fragmentation -> GPU OOMs and container restarts. Mitigations applied: per-tenant prefill abort >50k, runtime trimming+streaming enabled, kv_reservation multiplier reduced, node cordoned and driver update. Customer comms drafted.

Customer Success: Notification sent to impacted customers with troubleshooting steps and guidance to use embeddings or chunked context.

eng-runtime: Suggested long-term fixes: add adaptive KV allocation (grow-on-demand), per-tenant burst quotas, and automated fallback to quantized models for >32k contexts. Created ticket RT-814 for tracking.

Jaime: Handing off to Priya for overnight watch at 04:00 UTC. Priya, checklist: monitor 5xx, confirm gpu-11 driver update completes, confirm no new >50k requests slip through, and escalate if 5xx >1% for 15m.

Priya: Taking it. Ill keep watch and will flip permanent universal cap to 32k if we see recurrence.

infra-bot: gpu-11 driver update scheduled and vendor-approved patch queued (ETA 3h).

Jaime: Closing pager. If any new crashes appear, re-page on-call and tag eng-runtime. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
